name: Refinishing Floors in a 1920s Seattle Bungalow
title-tag: Refinishing 1920s Seattle Bungalow Floors: A Local Guide
meta-description: Old-growth fir and oak in 1920s Seattle bungalows usually can be refinished. The thickness check, the black stains, the gaps — what a century home really needs.
post-summary: September 21, 2026 · Most 1920s Seattle bungalow floors can be refinished — old-growth fir and oak you can't buy anymore. The thickness check that decides it, what a century leaves in the wood, and the finish that won't turn fir orange.
